name: Distrobox
author: olafkfreund
description: Distrobox for Omarchy, on the bar and on a key: every box with its image and home, enter one in a terminal, start, stop, restart, upgrade or delete it, and create a new one from a form that knows every distrobox create flag. Create and upgrade stream their log into the panel.

barWidget.description: Your distrobox containers, running ones first. Driven from the keyboard: enter opens a terminal inside the box, s starts or stops it, r restarts, g upgrades, x deletes, c creates a new box, U upgrades every box, S stops every box, y copies the name, / filters, u refreshes, o shows the running log, and ? lists the lot inside the panel.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar glyph re-reads the container engine. The panel refreshes every 3 seconds while it is open, regardless of this.

schema.label: Container engine
schema.description: The engine your boxes live in. The list is read from it directly, and every distrobox command runs with DBX_CONTAINER_MANAGER set to it, so a docker setup never touches a podman box.

schema.label: Hide the bar icon when there are no boxes
schema.description: On removes the button from the bar until there is a box to show.
